name: Zillow
description: Zillow Group publishes separate real-estate data and partner products for MLS listings, public records and metrics, Zestimates, rentals, mortgages, reviews, leads, and transactions.
agentUseSummary: Zillow cannot yet be connected through Relay. Zillow's current developer catalog is a portfolio of unrelated public datasets and approved-licensee or invite-only partner APIs, not one delegated Zillow consumer account API. Product, data-license, and compliance owners must select an exact dataset and permitted user experience before Relay requests access or builds tools.

blocked.label: Connect Zillow
blocked.description: Connect remains unavailable until Relay selects a specific Zillow Group product, dataset, license, audience, and authority contract.

blocked.label: Read Zillow data
blocked.description: Listings, MLS records, public records, addresses, valuations, rents, reviews, leads, contacts, mortgage data, transactions, profiles, and private consumer data remain unavailable.

blocked.label: Store or distribute Zillow data
blocked.description: Caching, bulk access, redistribution, dataset enhancement, unattributed display, unapproved sites, and uses outside an exact license are blocked.

blocked.label: Manage leads or transactions
blocked.description: Posting leads, changing listings or rentals, syncing contacts, opening or editing transactions, sending applications, and mortgage operations are blocked before product-specific approval.

blocked.label: Use private or raw Zillow interfaces
blocked.description: Private APIs, scraping, browser automation, cookie or credential capture, arbitrary requests, bulk export, and endpoints inferred from Zillow applications are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No Zillow action is enabled until the exact product and license are frozen, Zillow and any MLS or data owner approve access, and representative attribution, display, retention, privacy, accuracy, fair-housing, financial and revocation acceptance passes.

providerSetup.blocker: Zillow Group's current developer catalog lists close to twenty separate offerings across agent reviews, MLS and broker listings, mortgages, public records and market datasets, rentals, transactions and Zestimates. Some research datasets are downloadable with attribution; MLS listing access is invite-only and controlled by individual MLS partners; other APIs require preapproved licensee status and product-specific approval. Zillow's API terms impose site approval, credential confidentiality, immediate transactional display, no retention or bulk access, branding and attribution, use restrictions, limits, review and termination rights. The generic Marketplace label does not identify the data product, user, site, license, geography, permissible storage, display, downstream use, or whether any delegated account is involved.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, data-governance, legal, fair-housing, financial-compliance and security owners should select one bounded Zillow Group offering and documented user outcome. Prefer a no-credential published research dataset when it satisfies the need. For licensed property or MLS data, the exclusive partner task must obtain Zillow and source-owner approval for Relay's exact site and agent experience and freeze attribution, branding, fields, freshness, retention, caching, bulk prevention, rate, audit and deletion rules. Mortgage, lead, rental, review and transaction products require separate decisions and acceptance. Representative tests must prove data provenance and freshness, address and owner privacy, valuation disclaimers, fair-housing neutrality, financial non-advice, query limits, no bulk extraction, immediate deletion, credential rotation, and termination denial before any tool is enabled.

evidence.supports: Zillow Group presents a catalog of distinct APIs and datasets across agents, MLS and broker listings, mortgages, public data, rentals, transactions and Zestimates, with both public and partner offerings.

Zillow's API terms apply to preapproved licensees and approved sites and restrict credential sharing, retention, bulk access, redistribution, marketing use and presentation while requiring branding, attribution and compliance.
Zillow Group documents Bridge MLS listing access as invite-only, normalized to RESO, and subject to the discretion of individual MLS partners.
Zillow distinguishes parcel and transaction public-record APIs from downloadable neighborhood data and real-estate research metrics.
Zillow publishes aggregate research datasets as downloadable CSV files for public use with proper and clear attribution, a different contract from account or property APIs.
